author: JForce
quote: I can't imagine anyone liking this game except some women and real-life cuckolds. One of the worst slaps in the face of any game ever. Not a GTA game and it would **** even if it wasn't a GTA title. Between all the shady business stuff from Rockstar, the glitchy mess, terrible story, removing key features that make this game series great, empathy system, unfailable missions, like 5% of the crime of previous games, being a total dog for a girlboss who hid your own child from you, what the hell is there to like in this game? The graphics? Sure great to see them in under 30fps. Voice acting? Jason sounds like he gargles peanut butter every time he speaks. This belongs 100% in the trash. NOTHING of value here.
